verdict.rationale: Customer.io exposes APIs (Pipelines, Track, App API) that can be used to pull profile and event data out programmatically, and it supports generic 'data-out' integrations, but there's no documented one-click or CLI export of the *entire* audience (contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, suppression list) into a single open format like CSV. Achieving a full audience export would require custom API scripting, not a self-serve export feature.  missing for 10: dedicated bulk/full-audience export tool, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export of suppression list and tags, self-serve UI export flow, independent confirmation of complete data portability.
